Setting Up a Two-Node Inference Server
2026-06-30
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  │ The full procedure below is long. You can skip to Pitfalls and fixes      
  │ https://blog.konakona.dev/en/posts/server-setup/#pitfalls-and-fixes if you
  │ only want the troubleshooting notes.                                      

  ## Environment                                                              
                                                                            
  Set these on both machines:                                                 
                                                                            
    export WORKSPACE=/home/YOUR_USER/inference-setup                          
    export MODEL_PATH="$WORKSPACE/models/example-model"                       
    export WORKER_A_IP=10.0.0.11                                              
    export WORKER_B_IP=10.0.0.12                                              
                                                                            
  WORKER_A_IP and WORKER_B_IP must be private addresses that the two servers  
  can use to reach each other directly.                                       
                                                                            
  ## Check the image                                                          
                                                                            
    docker pull "$SERVING_IMAGE"                                              
    docker image inspect "$SERVING_IMAGE" \                                   
      --format 'id={{.Id}} architecture={{.Architecture}} created={{.Created  
    ↪   }} quoted argument with spaces'                                       
                                                                            
  1. Pull the image on both machines.                                         
  2. Compare the image IDs:                                                   
    • they must match exactly;                                                
    • otherwise re-pull with --platform linux/amd64.                          
  3. Start the workers.                                                       
                                                                            
  ## Pitfalls and fixes                                                       
                                                                            
   Symptom                │ Cause                   │ Fix                     
  ────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────
   Tasks fail during      │ Image pulls time out on │ Pre-pull every image    
   setup before the agent │ an unstable network     │ and verify its          
   starts                 │                         │ architecture before     
                          │                         │ starting the run        
   Router returns 502     │ A worker is still       │ Wait for both health    
                          │ loading weights         │ checks                  
                                                                            
    def ready(workers):                                                       
        return all(w.health() == "ok" for w in workers)  # a deliberately lo  
    ↪     ng comment that will not fit in narrow terminals
